Landing.whyTitle: Why can't you see this data anywhere else?
Landing.reason1Title: Aggregators want you inside their app
Landing.reason1Text: Google Flights, Hopper, and Kayak track price history internally — but lock the charts behind your account. A shareable link sends users to a page that isn't theirs.
Landing.reason2Title: “Buy or Wait” is more profitable than transparency
Landing.reason2Text: A black-box prediction keeps you dependent on their platform. Giving you a chart with direct airline links means they earn nothing.
Landing.reason3Text: If you can see that a route always dips 3 weeks before departure, that undermines dynamic pricing. That's why there's no public API.
Landing.how1Text: The setup script auto-detects Claude Code or Codex on your machine. If you have either, no API key needed. Or run a local model with Ollama, llama.cpp, or vLLM — completely free.
Landing.how2Text: Describe a flight, stay or car rental in plain language. Hotel and car forms also work without AI. Review dates, guests or drivers before searching.
Landing.how3Text: Follow price history and receive alerts. Flight charts can be shared; hotel and car histories stay on your instance. Open the provider link when you are ready to book.
Landing.notAggregatorText: Traveller does not sell rankings or earn a booking commission. Links supplied by travel providers may contain their own tracking parameters.
Landing.notAiText: AI is becoming a commodity — we don't bundle or resell it. Bring your own key, use Claude Code / Codex, or run Ollama / llama.cpp / vLLM locally.
Landing.notPredictorText: No black-box “buy now” advice. Traveller shows you real price history and lets you decide when the moment is right.
Landing.selfHostLead: Decentralization isn't a philosophy — it's the only design that works.
Landing.benefit1Title: It can't work any other way
Landing.benefit1Text: A centralized service scraping Google Flights gets IP-banned within days. Thousands of self-hosted instances, each making a few quiet requests from different IPs, is the only architecture that survives.
Landing.benefit2Text: No one sees what routes you're watching or when you're planning to travel. Airlines can't use your search history against you.
Landing.benefit3Title: Free with Claude Code, Codex, or a local model
Landing.benefit3Text: Use your existing CLI subscription, or run Ollama / llama.cpp / vLLM locally — zero API cost. Otherwise, extraction costs under $0.001 per query.
Landing.benefit4Text: Default is every 3 hours. Want every hour? Change one setting. Your data, your database — export it, analyze it, keep it forever.
Landing.travelTagline: Flight, hotel and rental car prices, under your control.
Landing.travelIntro: Track each part of your travel independently. Hotel and car searches never require a flight.
Landing.flightsText: Track routes and airlines over time, compare flexible dates, and share flight price charts.
Landing.carsText: Search DiscoverCars and Auto Europe. Compare verified totals among checked offers, review driver requirements and see deposits and excess separately. Missing fees and unconfirmed extras stay visible.
Landing.hotelsText: Search Google Hotels and Booking.com by dates, rooms, and guests. Track a hotel or room rate and set a target-price alert.
Landing.travelHousehold: In multi-user mode, everyone enters with the shared password or a passkey, then chooses a profile with personal trackers. Use flights, hotels and rental cars in any combination.
Landing.travelAvailability: Searches run on your own installation. Each tracker works independently. Complete bookings with the provider; Traveller does not bundle reservations.
